texts.preamble: Santosh S/O Baliram Pawade vs State Of Mah. Thr. Secretary Dept Food, ... on 20 October, 2020 Author: Avinash G. Gharote Bench: S.B. Shukre, Avinash G. Gharote (1) In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench : Nagpur Criminal Writ Petition No.505 Of 2020 Santosh s/o Baliram Pawade ..Vs.. The State of Maharashtra, through its Secretary Department Food, Civil Supplies a Consumer Protection, Mantralaya, Mumbai 32 and others ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders of directions and Registrar's orders ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Shri N. S. Khandewale, Counsel for the pe Smt. K. R. Deshpande, Addl. P. P. for the Coram : Sunil B. Avinash G Dated : 20/10/2020 Heard Shri Khandewale, learned Counsel for the petitioner. By this petition, the petitioner has prayed for direction to the police Authorities for registration of the Fir for various offences including the offence of cheating against the respondent nos. 6 to 11 on the ground that these respondents, in spite of earning handsome income annually, which is much more than annual income of Rs.44,000/-, have received food grains under a Government scheme, called Priority Household Scheme. (2) 1.wp.505.2020
texts.facts: It is submitted that the respondents being not poor, were not at all entitled to receive such benefits. The petitioner claims to be a social worker interested in social cause. The petitioner has obtained certain documents in proof of his contentions regards income earned by some respondents out of the respondent nos. 6 to 11. These respondents belong to village Bibi and village Nanda. Obviously, the cause being canvassed through this petition appears to be private one and not public and therefore, this petition deserves to be (3) 1.wp.505.2020 dismissed on the ground of questionable agenda of the petitioner.
